description: Spreads several occurences of an input image in a circle or spiral pattern.

inputs.description: The input image or atlas of 4 or 16 input images
inputs.name: in

inputs.description: The mask applied to the pattern
inputs.name: mask

instance: vec4 splatter_$(name)(vec2 uv, int count, int rings, inout vec3 instance_uv, vec2 seed, float _seed_variation_, vec4 _controlled_variation_) {
instance_uv = mix(instance_uv, vec3(full_uv, seed.x), step(c, c1));
name: Circle Splatter

outputs.description: Shows a random color for each instance of the input image
outputs.label: Instance map

outputs.description: Per instance UVs. Can be used with Custom UV node.
outputs.label: Instance UV

parameters.description: The number of occurences of the input image
parameters.label: Count
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: The number of rings of the circle pattern
parameters.label: Rings
parameters.name: rings

parameters.description:
The input type of the node:
- 1: single image
- 4: atlas of 4 images
- 16: atlas of 16 images
Atlases can be created using the Tile2x2 node.
parameters.label: Inputs
parameters.name: inputs

parameters.description: The scale of input images on the X axis
parameters.label: Scale X
parameters.name: scale_x

parameters.description: The scale of input images on the Y axis
parameters.label: Scale Y
parameters.name: scale_y

parameters.description: The radius of the outer circle pattern
parameters.label: Radius
parameters.name: radius

parameters.description:
The type of pattern:
- 0: circles
- 1: spiral
parameters.label: Spiral
parameters.name: spiral

parameters.description: The rotate increment along the pattern
parameters.label: Inc Rotate
parameters.name: i_rotate

parameters.description: The scale increment of the pattern
parameters.label: Inc Scale
parameters.name: i_scale

parameters.description: The random rotation applied to each image instance
parameters.label: Rnd Rotate
parameters.name: rotate

parameters.description: The random scale applied to each image instance
parameters.label: Rnd Scale
parameters.name: scale

parameters.description: The random grayscale value applied to each image instance
parameters.label: Rnd Value
parameters.name: value
